To add, delete, and update records, see Add, modify, and delete records
(/dns/docs/records).
To create, update, list, and delete managed zones, see Managing zones (/dns/docs/zones).
To find solutions for common issues that you might encounter when using Cloud DNS,
see Troubleshooting (/dns/docs/troubleshooting).
gcloud
(#gcloud)
gcloud dns managed-zones describe ZONE_NAME edit
gcloud
(#gcloud)
watch dig example.com in MX @ZONE_NAME_SERVER edit
To reference the API, see Cloud DNS REST API (/dns/docs/reference/v1).
To get an overview of Cloud DNS, see Cloud DNS overview (/dns/docs/overview).
